# Explosive payload

Internal ID: BombSiege | Type: Catapult Ammo | Source: Workbench | Crafting Materials: Sulfur x2, Proustite powder x3, Asksvin hide x2

# Introduction

The Explosive Payload is ammunition for the Catapult. It explodes dealing pure, chop and pickaxe damage in a 3-meter radius. It can destroy any structure that is able to receive damage.
Similarly to Lava Blobs, the explosion generated on impact can alter terrain.

## Availability

• Made at the Workbench.
